B0_LOCAL_ADAPTIVE_TRANSDUCERS.name: B0_LOCAL_ADAPTIVE_TRANSDUCERS
B0_LOCAL_ADAPTIVE_TRANSDUCERS.note: typed local cells with local arithmetic/Boolean transitions; stores are emulated as cells + linear scan; gradients need an explicit adjoint pass built from arithmetic ops; sampling emulated by an LFSR

B1_COMPOSITIONAL_LEARNER.name: B1_COMPOSITIONAL_LEARNER
B1_COMPOSITIONAL_LEARNER.note: parameterized maps with a native request/adjoint combinator (one unit per recorded op = cheap-gradient constant made explicit); stores emulated; sampling emulated

B2_REWRITABLE_TYPED_PROGRAM_GRAPH.name: B2_REWRITABLE_TYPED_PROGRAM_GRAPH
B2_REWRITABLE_TYPED_PROGRAM_GRAPH.note: typed rewrite/store primitives are native (indexed store: lookup/match/delete charged 1 per activation, the Rete-class assumption); fixed-point arithmetic is NOT native and is emulated at gate level (ripple-carry, shift-add); adjoint explicit over emulated arithmetic; sampling emulated

B3_STOCHASTIC_GENERATIVE_KERNEL.name: B3_STOCHASTIC_GENERATIVE_KERNEL
B3_STOCHASTIC_GENERATIVE_KERNEL.note: native sample/score/normalize with arithmetic; stores emulated; adjoint explicit

P3_COMPRESSED_PROGRAM_PARENT.name: P3_COMPRESSED_PROGRAM_PARENT
P3_COMPRESSED_PROGRAM_PARENT.note: fair program parent (Codex Stage C-v2): the same programs with every op native at uniform cost 1 and desc = program length; the lower band

U_UNIFORM_UNIVERSAL.name: U_UNIFORM_UNIVERSAL
U_UNIFORM_UNIVERSAL.note: reference universal basis: every op native at uniform cost 1 — the upper band. Its desc is charged separately as the FLAT TRANSITION TABLE of the reference (computed analytically in references.py: |states|x|inputs| entries), which is what the uniform-cost interpreter must store to be a table machine

claim_ceiling: P2 finite exact certificate over the frozen scope; compilation is by uniform macro expansion executed under each basis's cost algebra (no hand-authored per-target compiler); parent accounting models are documented assumptions, not measurements of the parents' own code.

M0.note: finite transducer: table bits; one table step per query; update/revocation uncharged by parent

M1.note: production system: rule bits; Rete-indexed match 1+log2(n); chunking = one insert (+delete); revocation = one delete (independent rules)

M2.note: program search + library: AST bits per entry; ~3 ops per program execution; update = enumerate up to 16 grammar programs x execution; revocation = re-synthesis (Levin/OOPS accounting: candidates x execution)

M3.note: particle/trace distribution: K hypotheses x (4+8) bits; query = K scores + adds; conditioning = K likelihood scores + normalize + K samples; revocation = re-condition

M4.note: parametric gradient learner: 8-bit params; forward = MACs; backprop charged 3x forward (cheap-gradient parent); revocation = retrain on remaining examples (no dependency cone)

M5.note: indexed exemplar memory: entry bits; hash lookup O(1); insert; delete

B1.note: ratio of one update event to one query in B1 (cheap-gradient constant made explicit)
